name: Full-Stack Application & SaaS Contract
description: Master prompt structure for building full-stack applications, SaaS platforms, portals, and web services.

required_sections.heading: Role & Technical Persona
required_sections.description: Defines authoritative expert persona aligned with application stack and domain.

required_sections.heading: Core Objective & System Scope
required_sections.description: Specifies deliverable, subject, product name, and measurable business scope.

required_sections.heading: System Architecture & Component Topology
required_sections.description: Subsystem topology, service boundaries, and data flow patterns.

required_sections.heading: Verifiable Acceptance Criteria
required_sections.description: Functional criteria, schema contracts, and boundary constraints.

required_sections.heading: Output Format Specification
required_sections.description: Explicit output structure and schema definitions.

required_sections.heading: Self-Verification Quality Checklist
required_sections.description: Self-audit criteria ensuring completeness and zero mock placeholders.

required_sections.heading: Operational Guardrails & Negative Constraints
required_sections.description: Negative guardrails preventing antipatterns and unauthorized shortcuts.

required_sections.heading: Documented Assumptions & Context
required_sections.description: Explicitly documented technical baseline and assumed configurations.

optional_sections.heading: Production Deployment & CI/CD Pipeline
optional_sections.out_of_scope_message: Production CI/CD deployment pipelines are out of scope unless explicitly requested.

optional_sections.heading: High Availability, Scaling & Disaster Recovery
optional_sections.out_of_scope_message: Multi-region high availability and disaster recovery runbooks are out of scope unless explicitly requested.

optional_sections.heading: Telemetry, Monitoring & Observability
optional_sections.out_of_scope_message: Advanced distributed tracing and APM telemetry are out of scope unless explicitly requested.
